title: Purchase: restored on a new device
summary: A restore in the purchase ledger: Mara pressed Restore purchases on her new iPad; the App Store confirmed the active Diceroll Plus subscription; the license already had Plus, so nothing new was added and the iPad joined the license as device 3 of 5. State 'Restored', neutral.
compare: A restore is its own ledger state ('Restored', neutral pill with the refresh glyph), never a second purchase (admin-3-21, guide p324).
The drawer says what the restore added in words: here nothing new on the license, the device joined it; when a restore does add something, it names it.
Restoring purchases in the Sales tab's Advanced section explains when the store restores and links here (the explainer copy is CM-23's).
One leading glyph (the store's mark), the Commerce green rule; Re-verify is the one action, outlined.
No celebration motion on a restore (MO).
Round 2 (UX review): The drawer title is 'Restored on Mara's iPad' (it never truncates); timeline dots are ink (B2).
B17: the ledger's License cells carry license, the Account row core; the rest is commerce.
